name: pipeline-kquant-repack-gemm
title: K-quant repack GEMM 流水化/成熟(结构 opening→吞吐)
description: board 证:q6_K/q2_K/q3_K repack GEMM 数值 silicon-confirmed + opponent-absence 证(L1 结构 opening),但 prefill LOSS ~5-6×(un-pipelined、~0.2 MAC/cycle、~20× off peak;q2_K GEMM 77 vsetvli)vs opponent MATURE _vl128 block-dot。结构 opening 存在但当前构造未转吞吐。修=repack GEMM 流水化(减 vsetvli churn、软流水、LMUL 调度)使 K-quant 逐格达 q4_0-类 5.9× 吞吐。q4_K/q5_K 亦需(q4_K parity/q5_K vs untuned)。这是 L1 矿脉从'结构逐格复制'到'吞吐逐格复制'的成熟工作。
